title: pulicaria arabica subsp. hispanica
intro: Pulicaria arabica subsp. hispanica, commonly known as Goat's Beard, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pulicaria arabica subsp. hispanica include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
